description: Picks one of fourteen chords at random and plays it from a root note, as four channels of pitch

inputs.text: The root note the chord is built from, at 1V per octave
A rising edge picks a fresh chord at random

outputs.text: Four channels of pitch: the root, and the notes of the chord measured from it in semitones
Four channels saying which notes of the chord are real: 10V on a channel that is playing and 0V on one the chord does not use

notes: nothing comes out until both the root input and the poly output are patched; with either unpatched the module stops and the outputs hold their last values.
where the chosen chord has fewer than four notes, the spare channels of the pitch output carry the root two octaves down rather than silence; the gate output says which to use.
the fourteen chords are major, minor, augmented and diminished triads; power chords in those three flavours; first inversions of the four triads; and minor, dominant and diminished sevenths.
a lamp shows which chord is current, one lamp per chord, and the choice is saved with the patch.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
